python3 - << 'PY'
import os, subprocess, sqlite3, shutil, hashlib

def run(args):
    r = subprocess.run(["python3","tasks.py",*args], capture_output=True)
    print("CMD", args, "exit", r.returncode, "out", r.stdout, "err", r.stderr)

base="/tmp/ledger-probe/edge"
shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(base)

print("--- blank title new db ---")
p=f"{base}/blank.db"
run(["--db", p, "add", "   "])
print("exists", os.path.exists(p), "dir", os.listdir(base))

print("--- missing id new db ---")
p=f"{base}/missing.db"
run(["--db", p, "done", "1"])
print("exists", os.path.exists(p))
if os.path.exists(p):
    c=sqlite3.connect(p)
    print("tables", c.execute("SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master").fetchall())
    print("rows", c.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks").fetchall() if True else None)

print("--- add then fail done, data remains ---")
p=f"{base}/keep.db"
run(["--db", p, "add", "keep me"])
run(["--db", p, "done", "5"])
run(["--db", p, "list"])

print("--- readonly db ---")
p=f"{base}/ro.db"
run(["--db", p, "add", "x"])
os.chmod(p, 0o444)
run(["--db", p, "add", "y"])
run(["--db", p, "list"])
os.chmod(p, 0o644)

print("--- directory as db ---")
run(["--db", base, "list"])

print("--- help? ---")
run(["--help"])

print("--- add help ---")
run(["--db", p, "add", "-h"])

print("--- title only whitespace unicode ---")
p=f"{base}/ws.db"
run(["--db", p, "add", "\u3000"])  # ideographic space
run(["--db", p, "add", "\t\n"])
run(["--db", p, "add", " a\u3000b "])
run(["--db", p, "list"])
run(["--db", p, "export"])

print("--- json separators exact and trailing newline ---")
r=subprocess.run(["python3","tasks.py","--db",f"{base}/keep.db","list"], capture_output=True)
print(list(r.stdout))

print("--- done already done is ok ---")
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "done", "1"])
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "list"])

print("--- large id ---")
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "done", "999999999999"])

print("--- negative id ---")
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "done", "-1"])

print("--- zero id ---")
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "done", "0"])

print("--- extra args ---")
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "list", "extra"])
run(["--db", f"{base}/keep.db", "add", "one", "two"])
PY
